**Top‑4 most‑subscribed YouTube channels (2025) and the year each channel was launched**

| Rank (2025) | YouTube channel | Year the channel was created (launched) |
|------------|----------------|------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **T‑Series** | **2006** – The channel was opened on 13 March 2006. |
| 2 | **MrBeast** | **2012** – Jimmy Donaldson created the “MrBeast” channel in February 2012 (originally under the name “MrBeast6000”). |
| 3 | **Cocomelon – Nursery Rhymes** | **2006** – The channel began as “ABCG” (later “ABC Kid TV”) in 2006; it was rebranded to “Cocomelon – Nursery Rhymes” in 2018. |
| 4 | **SET India** (Sony Entertainment Television) | **2006** – The official SET India channel was launched on 14 March 2006. |

*Note:* Subscriber counts shift constantly, but as of the latest publicly available data in 2025 these four channels hold the highest subscriber totals on the platform. The “year started” refers to the date the YouTube channel was first created, not the year the parent brand or company began operating.
